title: .gsd-recipe/config.json
description: Recipe runtime configuration (TASK-011). Validates the actual shape .gsd-recipe/scripts/install.sh and bench/lib/tracker-sync-config.sh write today (confirmed against a real scratch-repo install run — see bench/report/capability-config-schema-integration-report.md). Normative field table also lives in docs/netapp-recipe/contracts/DATA-CONTRACTS.md#config-json; this file is that table's machine-readable, strictly-validating counterpart. additionalProperties is deliberately true at every level: install.sh's own config_json_merge()/tracker-sync-config.sh comments document config.json as 'may hold other keys' that other, not-yet-written components may add later, so unknown keys must never fail validation.

tracker.description: Which tracker tracker-sync dispatches on. Written by bench/lib/tracker-sync-config.sh (via install-tracker-sync.sh) — defaults to 'jira' the first time that installer runs, never overwrites an existing value. Optional here (not in DATA-CONTRACTS.md's required table) because get-tracker itself treats an absent key as 'jira' rather than erroring — a config.json that predates the tracker-sync installer, or one hand-authored before it runs, is still valid.

traceability.description: Master switch for sync/reconcile behavior. Written unconditionally by install.sh's config_json_merge() on every fresh install.

reason.description: Operator reason for disabling traceability. Only enforced as required+non-empty when enabled is false (see the if/then below) — matches DATA-CONTRACTS.md's 'required when disabled' rule and install.sh --verify's own assert.

observer.description: Enable/disable the p2 FOTW observer *recommendation* recorded in config.json. Distinct from .gsd-recipe/observer-config.json, which install-observer.sh writes separately and which actually drives the observer loop. Written unconditionally by install.sh's config_json_merge() on every fresh install.

interval_minutes.description: Loop interval recommendation. Only enforced as required when enabled is true (see the if/then below) — matches DATA-CONTRACTS.md's 'required when observer enabled' rule and install.sh --verify's own assert.

assignee.description: Default Jira display name or email used when creating Epics and phase tasks (lookupJiraAccountId). Overridden by --assignee.

onboard.description: Onboard-path flags. skip_tracker is set by recipe-onboard --skip-tracker after PRD + planning without Jira.
